name: Renewable Battery Connect
notes: Powered by Texture; residential battery + solar DER, $250/kW upfront + $100/year, up to 60% / 60 events/year.

name: ConnectedSolutions (National Grid Massachusetts)
notes: MA-specific battery + smart thermostat options; also administered by Eversource.

name: ConnectedSolutions (Eversource Massachusetts)
notes: Eversource MA ConnectedSolutions+ business pilot; battery + thermostat options available across Eversource MA.

name: ConnectedSolutions (Eversource Connecticut)
notes: CT thermostat program; Eversource CT battery enrollments stopped after Dec 2023 per utility page.

name: ConnectedSolutions (National Grid Upstate New York)
notes: Upstate NY residential battery program under the ConnectedSolutions brand.

name: Smart Usage Rewards (Con Edison)
notes: C&I demand response for Con Edison NY; CSRP, DLRP, and automated dynamic load management groups.

name: Smart Usage Rewards (Orange & Rockland)
notes: C&I demand response for Orange & Rockland (O&R) NY; CSRP, DLRP, and reservation payment options.

name: Emergency Load Reduction Program
notes: Seven-year CAISO emergency battery-discharge pilot administered by PG&E; ~$2/kWh for dispatched battery energy.

name: Demand Response Programs
notes: Residential programs include Smart Energy (smart thermostat) and Summer Discount Plan; commercial programs at /business/demand-response.

name: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
notes: Customer-owned battery VPP; Tesla Powerwall and 10+ other battery brands; $850-$950/kW enrolled.

name: PowerPair
notes: Residential solar + battery storage pilot in Duke Energy Carolinas and Progress NC service areas.

name: EnergyWise Home
notes: Residential bill-credit program for load curtailment; available in FL and the Carolinas; includes switch option.

name: Storage Rewards
notes: Five-year residential battery pilot; May-Oct conservation days; ~$110/avg avg kW each season.

name: Battery Partner
notes: Residential battery VPP; bill credits for discharging during peak demand.

name: Smart Battery Pilot
notes: PGE residential battery VPP pilot; up to 9.5 MW; 10-15 dispatch events/year.
